eva_sales: CarterSec emailed a last-minute SIG checklist: clear line on key custody, proof HSM prevents export, rotation cadence, and a tiny live check we can run in the POC. Need a short deliverable pack they can consume in 20 mins.

imelda_security: We'll give a 1-page CAIQ-focused note + minimal evidence. Key lines: in-transit TLS1.3, at-rest AES-256 with envelope encryption. Modes: Redwood-managed CMK (we manage key lifecycle) vs BYOK (customer-owned CMK in customer's cloud/HSM). For HSM-backed CMKs (AWS CloudHSM, Azure Dedicated HSM, Thales via Private adapter) key material is non-exportable by design; include vendor FIPS/attestation PDFs.

carter_cust: Can you confirm whether Redwood ever holds plaintext for BYOK flows? That is a gating control for our auditor.

imelda_security: Short: No. For BYOK/imported keys the customer retains key material; Redwood only receives key references or ciphertext. Legal carve for SOW: "Redwood does not escrow or retain customer key material for BYOK/imported keys."

mike_sre: For live POC test we can provide two one-liners depending on cloud: AWS CLI (against customer's key) or an Azure import example. AWS single-line demo (we'll give role/grant steps separately):
`aws kms generate-data-key --key-id alias/RedwoodPOC --key-spec AES_256 --query CiphertextBlob --output text | base64 --decode > ct.bin && aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://ct.bin --query Plaintext --output text | base64 --decode > pt.bin`

mike_sre: Azure import quick check (one step to import a PEM and then call our endpoint):
`az keyvault key import --vault-name myVault --name pocKey --pem-file ./cust_key.pem`
`# then call Redwood POC with key reference`

dana_commercial: Procurement line for SOW: "BYOK/import support available; on-prem HSM adapter may incur a one-time integration fee and optional support add-on. Commercial team to provide quote."

imelda_security: We'll also include a redacted audit sample for their vendor CSV: { "eventTime": "2026-02-12T09:15:00Z", "eventName": "GenerateDataKey", "principal": "arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/RedwoodPOCRole", "keyId": "arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:REDACTED:key/abcd1234", "result": "Success" }

redwood_deploybot: POC created: redwood-poc-carter-eu-west1, demo CMK alias/RedwoodPOC provisioned, logging enabled.

eva_sales: Action items: @imelda_security one-pager + attestation PDFs + redacted audit; @mike_sre CLI samples + minimal grant steps; @dana_commercial SOW snippet. I'll bundle and send before the SIG. Carter, is 11:30 CET ok to review?

carter_cust: 11:30 CET works. If you can include the FIPS attestation and the single-line CLI we'll run it on the call. Thanks!"
